jobs.note: [est 30 min] T1b stress (A off): a pre-check rung without squeeze (fails fast if no lot-only entry or no empty plot), then a ts3probe squeeze (TEST-ONLY, probeTestSqueeze starts the probe with --test-squeeze, docs/51 §635) of the largest free block to 300, 270, 240 MB, Edit Town + place + bulldoze + save per rung, unsqueeze at the end; the first failure stops the job. No expectFail: a CRASH row is the expected finding (the crash capture names the site, 0xC88330 for the optimizer copy, I-040-1), a FAIL row is a harness or hollow failure to triage, a PASS means the blocks found room down to 240 MB (rerun with lower rungs). Required marks: the pre-check rung and the first squeeze rung.
